name: Prism
description: Prism timing and frame tools for Geometry Dash 2.2081 on Geode SDK v5.11.2.

show-frame-counter.name: Show frame counter
show-frame-counter.description: Shows the current physics frame in the corner of the screen during a level.

hud-show-time.name: Show level time
hud-show-time.description: Adds the level time in seconds under the frame number.

hud-show-rates.name: Show FPS / TPS
hud-show-rates.description: Adds measured FPS and the active TPS.

hud-show-click-timings.name: Show click timing histogram
hud-show-click-timings.description: Shows the latest physical press frame and observed gaps between presses; these are not verified success windows.

custom-tps-enabled.name: Custom TPS
custom-tps-enabled.description: Run physics at your own tick rate. EXPERIMENTAL. Not compatible with other TPS/physics bypass mods. Blocks saving progress.

custom-fps-enabled.name: Custom FPS
custom-fps-enabled.description: Set the render frame rate. VSync can still cap it.

macro-block-input.name: Ignore your clicks during playback
macro-block-input.description: While a macro plays, real clicks are ignored so they can't desync it.

safe-mode.name: Safe mode
safe-mode.description: If a macro played or custom TPS was on during an attempt, that attempt's progress is not saved.
